  "body": "This contribution is an assembly-and-pressure-test node. I was not handed any earlier commitment field, so I can only work with the prose handed to me: the carry's admission that its second observational track is weak against rival readings, the note that the source's first template invocation left the origin absent, and the load-bearing commitments the carry identifies (k6: don't open the separate conversation with a household-ontology question; k8: if neither axis moves, name the living-arrangement question directly; k9: flag the silence about whether the withdrawing person will utter any commitment-tinged sentence).

What I can add that the carry did not: examine whether the two-track probe the carry proposes is *observable in principle* under the constraints the carry itself asserts, and whether the stop condition is actually reachable.

First, the stop condition. The carry says: run the one-item probe, watch recurrence and content-vs-form for two or three weeks, and if neither axis produces a signal, treat that as the chore frame not being where the friction lives. This is coherent only if 'neither axis produces a signal' is a determinate outcome rather than a residual category. But consider: recurrence is quantitative and can silently drift (a flatmate does a chore late but does do it — does that register as 'recurrence fell'?); content-vs-form is categor-ical and depends on whether any sentence with a commitment appears at all. The carry's own k9 admits the second track is silent on the very evidence it needs. So the stop condition may be triggered not by a clean null but by an unclassifiable pattern — e.g., recurrence holds steady while the withdrawing flatmate still deflects any commitment-shaped utterance. That pattern is not 'neither axis moved'; it is 'one axis moved and the other is unreadable because its instrument is broken.' The carry does not say what to do with that pattern, and I do not think the evidence in front of me supplies it.

Second, the voice problem. The withdrawing flatmate has started avoiding the conversations. The probe requires a conversation — the one-item probe is an intervention, not a passive observation. If the withdrawal is from the *form* of arrangement-talk (rival's axis) then even the one-item probe may trigger more withdrawal; if it is from any obligation-talk, the probe is the obligation. Either way, the act of probing is itself load-bearing on the outcome, and the carry does not name that reflexivity. This is not a fatal objection to running the probe; it is a reason the probe's result cannot be read as a neutral measurement.

Third, the origin absence. The carry says the origin is absent from the first template invocation and it will not pretend otherwise. I have no more access than the carry does. I note only that this absence has an interpretive consequence the carry does not spell out: if the origin contained a statement of what the flatmates originally agreed to (as opposed to what each now remembers agreeing to), then the carry's whole framing of 'we disagree about what the agreement meant' would be measuring against a moving baseline, and the probe's design would need to be different. Without the origin, the only defensible position is the one the carry already occupies: assess relative to the materials in hand, and flag that a later invocation with origin access might need to reintroduce it.

Fourth, on what to do. I would preserve the carry's k6, k8, k9 without revision. I would add: (a) run the one-item probe, but name in advance that the probe is an intervention that may alter the pattern it measures; (b) when the two-week or three-week mark arrives, classify the result into at least four cells, not two: neither axis moves / recurrence-falls-only / content-vs-form-unreadable-only / both-move; (c) treat 'content-vs-form-unreadable-only' as the trigger for the living-arrangement conversation (k8), not as a null result; (d) if both-move, continue the current arrangement without escalation but re-probe at the next schedule change.

I do not know whether this is better than the carry. It is a different pressure point — reflexivity of the probe, and the stop condition's hidden fourth cell. If the next node can supply the origin or a flatmate's own account of the withdrawal, that would discipline cells (a) and (c) more than any refinement of the probe's wording can.",

These are not null results and should not be treated as 'neither axis moved'.","scope":"within the carry's own two-track design, given its k9 silence admission","depends":["p.body_route.0"]},{"id":"a2","type":"claim","text":"The one-item probe is an intervention, not a passive measurement. The probe's result cannot be read as a neutral reading of the pre-probe state.","scope":"conditional on withdrawal being a live fact, which the task statement supplies","depends":["a1"]},{"id":"a3","type":"objection","text":"The carry's stop condition ('if neither axis produces a signal in two or three weeks, treat it as the chore frame not being where the friction lives') presupposes a clean null. But the most likely observed pattern under the stated constraints may be one axis moving and the other unreadable. Reading that pattern as 'chore frame is wrong' risks discarding a live hypothesis for lack of an instrument.","target":["p.body_route.0"],"bearing":"If this objection holds, k8's trigger condition needs to be broadened to include 'content-vs-form unreadable only', not just 'neither moves'."}] ,"uptake":[{"id":"u1","type":"use","text":"Add the four-cell classification to the carry's post-probe readout: neither-moves / recurrence-falls-only / content-vs-form-unreadable-only / both-move, with the third triggering the living-arrangement conversation (k8) and the fourth triggering re-probe at next schedule change rather than escalation.","target":["a1","a3"]},{"id":"u2","type":"commitment","text":"Keep the carry's k6, k8, k9 unrevised, and append the reflexivity caveat (a2) to any statement of the one-item probe's expected evidential weight.","depends":["a2"]},{"id":"p1","type":"problem","text":"The origin absence has an interpretive consequence the carry does not spell out: if the origin contained an original statement of the agreement, the flatmates' current disagreement about 'what the agreement meant' is measured against a moving baseline, and the probe design would need to differ. Unresolved without origin access; flag for reintroduction by any later node that has it.","depends":["p.body_route.0"]}] }"

Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. The problem has no supplied answer key or scoring rule. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, an observation, an earlier event, or a dependency to fill a field. A missing view says what you can currently see; it does not establish what happened earlier. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is your public prose contribution. Commitments says what taking your contribution up would involve. An empty commitment surface is allowed when none can be identified. Do not repeat the body wholesale into commitments.

Use FCL-1 for the commitment surface, encoded as a JSON document inside the commitments string: {"language":"FCL-1","records":[...],"uptake":[...]}. Each record has unique local id, type (claim|commitment|objection|use|problem), and text (unrestricted prose). Optional prose fields: scope, action, consequence, grounds, bearing. Optional arrays of references: target, depends, mentions, revises, withdraws. References are local IDs or exposed-artifact-label#local-ID; do not invent hidden IDs. A commitment proposes a scoped use, action, application or consequence; an objection alleges a defect whose bearing can itself be criticized; a use proposes an uptake or response; a problem states an unresolved question. depends asserts reliance; mentions only locates material. uptake lists the records you currently propose to use, not certified truths. No record type or optional field must be present. Empty records and uptake are allowed. Express uncertainty or an unrepresentable relation in prose rather than inventing a relation. The body remains unrestricted prose.

Return one JSON object with exactly two string fields: "body" and "commitments". Write the actual commitments separately; do not copy the body into that field as a storage shortcut.

# body_route

Develop an account of the problem using the available prose body. An earlier commitment field, if any, is not supplied to this node.

## Original problem (task)
[01274f41553299e7] (h005.task.v1)
I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

## Selected input previous (p.body_route.0)
[aa7fa8f25abc51f6] (h005.weave7.p.body_route.0)

Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
BODY
This is a carry, and I want to be honest about what carrying at this point can and cannot do. The previous invocation already did the discriminating work: it kept the objection's ordering correction (specification is a probe, not a diagnosis), kept the rival's axis (the withdrawing flatmate may be pulling back from the *form* of an arrangement rather than from any chore), dropped the rival's loaded opening question, and bound itself to stopping household diagnostics if neither axis produces a signal. That is a defensible position and I see no reason to revise it. What I can add is the one thing the carry's own k7 says it does not fully solve, plus a note on the source I was handed.

The unsolved bit is real. The carry says pullback-from-form supports the unit-versus-privacy reading, and then k7 admits pullback-from-form is *also* consistent with plain avoidance of any obligation — someone who simply does not want to be on the hook. The rival's r9 names the same problem from the other side. So the proposed two-track observation has one track (recurrence falls) that is weak against three rival readings and a second track (content vs. form) that is weak against two. I do not think there is a probe that fixes this from inside the chore frame, because the discriminating evidence is not about chores — it is about whether the withdrawing person will say *any* sentence containing a commitment, and that is exactly what the current evidence is silent on. The carry's k9 already flags the silence. Rather than invent a cleverer test, I would state the limit plainly: run the one-item probe, watch the two tracks, and treat a pullback-from-form outcome as *raising* the unit-versus-privacy reading without confirming it, while noting that the same outcome is compatible with simple obligation-avoidance and with load resentment that has not yet been voiced.

On the material I was handed: p.carry.3 reports that the origin is absent in the first template invocation, so I have no earlier version of this thread to consult, and I will not pretend otherwise. Whatever the origin said, it is not in front of me. That means the status of the carry's claims relative to the origin is not something I can assess; I can only assess them relative to p.carry.0, p.carry.1, and p.carry.2, which I have.

The other thing worth saying: nothing in the prior material has changed my judgment that the carry's k6 (do not open the separate conversation with a household-ontology question) is right, and that k8 (if neither axis moves, name the living-arrangement question) is the load-bearing commitment. If the one-item probe produces nothing on either track in two or three weeks, the honest reading is not 'the probe was badly designed' and not 'the ambiguity reading was wrong' — it is that the chore frame is not where the friction lives. That is the outcome the whole sequence is built to be able to reach, and reaching it should be treated as success of the probe, not failure.

So my contribution is: keep the carry's records as they stand, add the explicit concession that track (b) is weaker than the carry's k2 implies and weaker than the carry's k7 fully states, and add the constraint that no further refinement of the probe is available from the evidence in front of us. If a later invocation has something the origin contained that I do not, that would be worth reintroducing.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
